question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A place of burial
solution:
The correct answer is: **Cemetery**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Cemetery"** refers to a place where dead bodies are buried, usually marked by tombstones or other monuments. (कब्रिस्तान)
 
• **​"Cemetery" **is a designated area for the burial of the dead, often affiliated with a church or a community.
 
 
• **Example: **The old **cemetery **in the village is a peaceful place where many generations of families are laid to rest.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Building **(इमारत): A structure with a roof and walls, such as a house or factory.

 
 
• **Example:** The new office **building **will be completed next year.
 
 
 
• **Laboratory **(प्रयोगशाला): A room or building equipped for scientific experiments, research, or teaching.
 
 
• **Example: **The scientists conducted their research in a state-of-the-art **laboratory**.
 
 
 
• **Observatory** (वेधशाला): A room or building housing an astronomical telescope or other scientific equipment for the study of natural phenomena.
 
 
• **Example:** The **observatory **offers a clear view of the night sky for stargazing.
